formula: (in-lap + next out-lap) - 2 * median(same-driver normal laps within 4 laps either side)

method.source: F1 official live timing through FastF1 3.8.3
method.pairFilter: Consecutive in-lap/out-lap, complete duration, both TrackStatus exactly 1, S/M/H only, no FastF1-generated laps. PitInTime/PitOutTime identify laps only; their difference is NEVER used.
method.baselineFilter: Same driver, within four race laps either side; no pit in/out, green, accurate, not deleted/generated, dry compound, complete duration, exclude race lap 1.
method.changeFromOriginalSevenCircuitCollector: Same formula and numeric gates; raw baseline laps and rejection reasons are now auditable. Generated pit laps and deleted/generated/first-race-lap baseline rows are explicitly excluded.

tracks.reason: Madrid has no race in the 2023-2025 collection range. Barcelona is a different circuit and is not substituted. No 2026 result is inferred.

limitations: Observational in/out-lap time-loss proxy, not stationary wheel-change duration or pit-lane telemetry.
Tyre compound change, warm-up, fuel progression and traffic can bias the local-baseline estimator.
A reported estimate requires three retained green/dry pairs. Wet/SC stops are excluded rather than treated as equivalent green pit losses.
Selected historical season is explicit and is not a claim about 2026 pit-lane rules, speed limits, tyre rules or car performance.
Single-event estimates are kept separate from the existing 2023-2025 pooled seven-circuit calibration.
